guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep long inference off the main thread and avoid render-blocking client work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied with dedicated module workers, lazy model download, cached auto-init, and type=module scripts.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Move work over 250ms to a worker and retain a scheduler.yield fallback for unavoidable main-thread loops.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All model work and batches are off-thread; the remaining DOM loops are small and bounded, so no artificial yield was added.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: /tmp/webai-g8-modern-guidance.md; worker.js batch method and worker-protocol bounded queue

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks, one h1, sequential headings, native buttons, labels, progress, and live status.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied across all five routes; code blocks use tabindex when scrollable and actions are buttons rather than links.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid/flex sizing, wrapping, min-inline-size:0, and responsive overflow containment.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied in DEMO_CSS with minmax tracks, wrapping control rows, one-column mobile layout, and scrollable wide tables.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give every control a persistent label, use native input types, and keep touch controls large.
